## Statement · **draft**
Let $A$ be a ring and $I \subseteq A$ an ideal. On the additive quotient group $A/I$ define

$(a+I)+(b+I) := (a+b)+I, \qquad (a+I)(b+I) := ab+I .$

These operations are well defined and make $A/I$ a ring, the **quotient ring**; the quotient map $\pi : A \to A/I$, $\pi(a) = a+I$, is a ring homomorphism with $\ker \pi = I$.
